messages.subject: Newsletter contribution: a playable Irish father-and-son game
messages.body:
Hi Imirt team,

I’m Kevin, the founder of Mythical Void in Ireland. I’m sharing this because your newsletter explicitly welcomes product launches and studio updates from the Irish game-development community.

Mythical Void began as a father-and-son experiment: what could a nine-year-old’s imagination and generative AI tools make possible? It has grown into a free browser adventure with strange creatures, six restorable realms, story choices and optional discoveries drawn from NASA’s public data.

The game is playable with no download or account: https://mythicalvoid.com/
A short fact sheet and clearly labelled press assets are here: https://mythicalvoid.com/press/

If useful, I can also share a short, honest studio note on what AI helped us do and which creative, safety and publishing decisions remain human.

Thanks for considering it,
Kevin
Mythical Void

messages.subject: Game submission: Mythical Void — free browser creature adventure
messages.body:
Hi Alpha Beta Gamer,

I’m Kevin, the developer of Mythical Void. I’m sending it because your submission page says you are looking for playable games in development and can cover full games on the site or YouTube.

Mythical Void is a free browser adventure. Players recover a crashed ship, hatch a strange creature, explore six damaged realms and choose what Project Beacon becomes. The creature system combines shapes, colours, temperaments, affinities and rare mutations into a wide range of outcomes.

Play immediately, with no download or account: https://mythicalvoid.com/
The fact sheet, real gameplay captures and clearly labelled marketing art are here: https://mythicalvoid.com/press/

The game is still developing, so honest feedback would be useful. If it is not a fit, no reply is needed.

Kevin
Mythical Void

messages.subject: Phaser showcase: Mythical Void browser game
messages.body:
Hi Phaser team,

I’m Kevin, the developer of Mythical Void. Your documentation invites developers to show what they have built with Phaser, so I wanted to ask whether this is suitable for the Phaser showcase.

Mythical Void is a free Phaser 3 browser adventure with a large world flow, six realms, creature genetics, restoration encounters and browser save support. We have also prepared a portable build for browser-game platforms while keeping the main site’s security rules intact.

Play it here: https://mythicalvoid.com/
The short fact sheet and real gameplay captures are here: https://mythicalvoid.com/press/

I’d be happy to provide a concise technical summary if that helps your review.

Kevin
Mythical Void
